theorem MemoryStorage.ApplySnapshot.spec_tok_of [package_sem : Assumptions] (wp_ApplySnapshot :
    MemoryStorage.ApplySnapshot.spec) : MemoryStorage.ApplySnapshot.spec_tok
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.MemoryStorage.ApplySnapshot.spec_tok`, unfolded:
  ∀ (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ σt : StorState) (sp : Loc) (sv : SnapshotM) (dq : DFrac) (eood : GoInterface),
    σ.pend = [] →
      uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' < 2 ^ 61 →
        uint.Z σ.fl ≤ uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' →
          uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' ≤ γs.cap →
            ⊢
              ∀ Φ,
                isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                    "Hms" ∷ ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ ∗
                      "Htok" ∷ memSnapTok ms γs σt ∗
                        "Hsnap" ∷ snapArg sp dq sv ∗
                          "#Hcert" ∷ memStorCert γs (snapTrip sv sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists) ∗
                            "#Herr" ∷ typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrSnapOutOfDate) eood DFrac.discard -∗
                  (▷
                      ∀ err,
                        ownSnapM sp dq sv ∗
                            (⌜σt.ss.index' ≠ W64 0 ∧ uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' ≤ uint.Z σt.ss.index' ∧ err = eood⌝ ∗
                                ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ ∗ memSnapTok ms γs σt ∨
                              ⌜¬(σt.ss.index' ≠ W64 0 ∧ uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' ≤ uint.Z σt.ss.index') ∧
                                    err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                ownMemoryStorage ms γs
                                    (have __src := memStorApplied sv;
                                    { prev := __src.prev, ents := __src.ents, ss := __src.ss, pend := __src.pend,
                                      scs := __src.scs, sal := __src.sal, sdat := __src.sdat, fl := σ.fl }) ∗
                                  memSnapTok ms γs (memStorApplied sv)) -∗
                          Φ (intoVal err)) -∗
                    WP
                      ((intoVal
                          (methods MemoryStorage.ty.PointerType
                            go!"ApplySnapshot"
                            (intoVal ms)))
                        (intoVal sp))
                      {{ Φ }}

theorem MemoryStorage.CreateSnapshot.wp_shared [package_sem : Assumptions] (wp_CreateSnapshot :
    MemoryStorage.CreateSnapshot.spec) (N : Namespace) (HN : ↑N ## ↑memSnapN) (ms : Loc) (γs :
    MemStorNames) (γss : GName) (x i : w64) (cs : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) (data :
    GoSlice) (bs : List w8) (eood : GoInterface) (Hx : uint.Z i ≤ uint.Z x) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, isPkgInit
    pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗ memSnapRO ms γs ∗ memKey γs.ak ∗ memFloorTok ms γs x ∗ ownCSM cs dq
    c ∗ ownSlice data bs (DFrac.own 1) ∗ typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrSnapOutOfDate) eood
    DFrac.discard ∗ (□ ∀ σ t, memStorCert γs (snapTrip (memSnapCreated σ i t (some c) bs)
    (memSnapCreated σ i t (some c) bs).Metadata'.ConfState'.lists)) ∗ inv N (memTokShared γs γss) -∗
    (▷ ∀ snap' err, memKey γs.ak ∗ ownCSM cs dq c ∗ monoNatLbOwn γss (uint.nat i) ∗ (⌜err = eood⌝ ∗
    ownSlice data bs (DFrac.own 1) ∨ ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗ ∃ σ t, ownSnapM snap' (DFrac.own 1)
    (memSnapCreated σ i t (some c) bs)) -∗ Φ (intoVal snap', intoVal err)) -∗ WP ((((intoVal
    (methods MemoryStorage.ty.PointerType go!"CreateSnapshot" (intoVal ms))) (intoVal i)) (intoVal
    cs)) (intoVal data)) {{ Φ }}

def memTokShared (γs : MemStorNames) (γss : GName) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ σt,
      memSnapTokG γs σt ∗ monoNatAuthOwn γss 1 (uint.nat σt.ss.index') ∗ ⌜uint.Z σt.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z σt.ss.index'⌝)

theorem MemoryStorage.Compact.wp_shared [package_sem : Assumptions] (wp_Compact :
    MemoryStorage.Compact.spec) (N : Namespace) (HN : ↑N ## ↑memSnapN) (ms : Loc) (γs :
    MemStorNames) (γss : GName) (x ci : w64) (sl : Nat) (ecomp : GoInterface) (Hx : uint.Z ci ≤
    uint.Z x) (Hsl : uint.Z ci ≤ ↑sl) (Hcap : uint.Z ci ≤ γs.cap) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, isPkgInit
    pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗ memSnapRO ms γs ∗ memFloorTok ms γs x ∗ typedPointsto (globalAddr
    ErrCompacted) ecomp DFrac.discard ∗ inv N (memTokShared γs γss) ∗ monoNatLbOwn γss sl -∗ (▷ ∀
    err, ⌜err = ecomp ∨ err = GoInterface.nil⌝ -∗ Φ (intoVal err)) -∗ WP ((intoVal (methods
    MemoryStorage.ty.PointerType go!"Compact" (intoVal ms))) (intoVal ci)) {{ Φ }}
